items.title: Dameon Pierce: Makes late exit in Week 7
items.description: Pierce didn't take the field for either of the Eagles' final two possessions of Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys after sustaining an undisclosed injury with 8:38 remaining in the fourth quarter, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia rep

items.title: Dallas Goedert: Five catches in Week 7 loss
items.description:
Goedert secured five of seven targets for 48 yards in the Eagles' 38-21 loss to the Cowboys on Monday night.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Makai Lemon: Paces pass catchers in Week 7 loss
items.description:
Lemon brought in seven of eight targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in the Eagles' 38-21 loss to the Cowboys on Monday night.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Suffers compensatory back injury
items.description: Barkley said after Monday's 38-21 loss to the Cowboys that he sustained a compensatory back injury, which he tried to play through after tweaking his injured hamstring on his first run of the game, EJ Smith of The Philadelphia Inquirer repo

items.title: Tanner McKee: Modest numbers in Week 7 loss
items.description:
McKee completed 23 of 35 passes for 211 yards with one touchdown and one interception and added one rush for one yard in the Eagles' 38-21 loss to the Cowboys on Monday night.
